report.explanation: Current telemetry shows all services healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 71ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters across gateway, order and payment. Order reports 340MB retained after GC, but no memory-retention history or baseline exists, so a leak cannot be established. No evidence supports any public cause; the alert is not corroborated by current observations.
missing_evidence: Memory-retention time series for order (and peers) to establish a sustained growth trend versus a static baseline
Baseline/expected memory footprint for order to judge whether 340MB retained is anomalous
Alert-aligned service facts identifying which service the checkout degradation alert concerns
Latency/error telemetry over a window matching the alert, since current window shows healthy p95 and error rate
